phrases.text: Video 1 shows the beginning and Video 2 shows the ending of one story. Which option best explains what happened in the missing interval?
They discovered a hidden map to a storm shelter but left behind visible clues.
They learned cooking techniques from a TV chef, creating noise that alerted the woman.
They fought a rival mouse group over a rare mushroom stored indoors.
They found a cat hiding in the pantry and lured it outside as diversion.
They accidentally ate hallucinogenic spices, causing erratic behavior.
They triggered an antique trap while stealing cheese from the counter.
a person holding a map with symbols pointing to a shelter
visible clues like torn paper or footprints near a door
a person watching a cooking show on television with loud sounds
a woman reacting to loud noises in a kitchen
mice fighting near a mushroom on a kitchen table
a group of mice chasing another group near a closed cabinet
a cat hiding behind a shelf in a pantry
a person using a toy to lure a cat toward an open door
